what: docstring history of why the board used to find nowhere to go when it avoided the woods
with no recorded crop (meta.view), the re-seat frames against the house-cloud bbox instead
reachable: no (the frame test's stub only; stage_frame always records meta.view first)

what: when every in-frame verge is refused as off-way (>15 deg) or under the village canopy, the best-ranked LOOSE seat is taken anyway and turned to its nearest way - the board can stand under the belt

reachable: rare (a hamlet whose every in-frame lane verge lies under its belt or beside a crossing straggler)

what: when no verge inside the frame takes a board at all, the engine's original seat (the one the guard just found outside the frame) is appended unchanged
rule: labels_within_image / the board's whole footprint inside the view (frame.py:170-195, settlement-review feature 227: Sawada shipped with no board drawn)
reachable: rare (pragma no cover; no cohort map reaches it)

what: title with no blank or cover-only pocket and every corner blocked grows a north title band and sits the placard there 'over nothing, unless a feature runs off the frame there, which the check still reports'; the stage_frame comment still describes the retired corner-overlap fallback

what: docstring: a cohort member finishes into a scratch directory and is thrown away
comment on snapshotting the kept roll for the report when a re-roll is rejected
a skeleton arm is routed round the fabric with _route; where no route exists the clipped (shortened, possibly vanished) arm is drawn instead; the clip is always applied
reachable: yes (router failure on a packed cluster; the declared Y/T form can lose an arm - recorded, and test_an_arm_with_nowhere_to_go_is_not_drawn_at_all states the drop)

what: dispersed hamlet draws no internal lane web (lane_skeleton none) - the researched form
comment recording a woodpile-yields fallback that was built, measured as a no-op and removed
the rolled side is tried first, then the other sides in listed order; a farmstead with no room keeps no strip
if every house is surface-watered the minimax objective falls back to all houses
relaxation ladder: the third-nearest neighborhood test loosens (190->300->520 px, then a pair) while the nearest-house bound stays ~105-112 px
comment: interior seat preferred over padded one as a tie-break, citing the rescue pass's in-cloud test
coverage rescue: a household beyond 760 ft of any water gets a ring-probed well; if no probe passes, nothing is placed and the household is left dry
rule: settlement_dwellings_watered - every dwelling within ~760 real ft of a well, channel, pond or stream (wells.py:271-274)
reachable: rare (pragma no cover: 'the bundle-pitch fix left the courtyards open enough that no cohort map strands a household')

what: last resort: open_seat over the house-cloud bbox with no among-the-dwellings or not-clustered test; if that finds nothing the map has no well

reachable: rare (pragma no cover; only when the whole lattice found nothing)

what: a fence end whose terminal segment never meets the wall snaps to the nearest wall point
a fence end further than `reach` from the wall is left exactly as placed, not joined

what: a kido with no lane through it squares to the local fence tangent
no clean bearing: the connector takes the least-bad candidate ranked (wet, steadings, crop/pond/brook)
rule: roads_clear_of_marsh and 'a path does not pass through marshland' (GM, track.py:614-620, wet.py toe_band); houses_off_corridors / TRACK_FABRIC_GAP (track.py:622-636: a through-road across the hamlet 'stays laid across'); pond/brook avoided outright (checks.py:149-152)
reachable: rare (a cluster pocketed so every one of 41 bearings is fouled)

what: field spur is the least-violating candidate, then clipped clear of crops/toe, trimmed off marsh and its tip set on the bund
reader honors the legacy M['lane'] key when M['lanes'] is absent (frozen fixtures)
geometry: a hairpin vertex takes the first edge's normal
when shapely raises or returns no polygon, the marsh is drawn UNCLIPPED - over the dike block, the fields and the pond
rule: the marsh is subtracted from the filled dike block, the fields and the pond (docstring wet.py:150-168, the GM's T54 complaint)
sketch: repair instead of reverting: buffer(0)/make_valid the inputs and retry, else drop the marsh record (a stated drop) rather than draw it over the crop

what: a two-point way whose whole length lies in wet ground is shortened to <=30 px and left with its soaked end
rule: 'a path does not run into a reed bed: it stops on the dry side of it' (trim_off_marsh docstring wet.py:430-433; roads_clear_of_marsh)
reachable: rare (a skeleton arm or stub lying entirely inside a marsh)

what: comment: the dispersed bundle drops the per-house grove gracefully in a dense cluster
garden side preference SE, SW, then the E/W walls
prefers a spot with grove-room, else yard+garden only; if even that fails the farmhouse is dropped
reachable: yes (legacy/dispersed path; the drop is the stated invariant-keeping rule)

what: comment: the placed list is rebound as Indexed so _fits keeps its index (uncached fallback)
at hamlet/village tiers only verge-band (6 ft) seats compete when any exists; otherwise the 60 ft band is the fallback
reachable: yes (the fallback is the recorded rule; test holds boards within 90 px)

what: constant rationale citing kosatsuba_by_the_road's 60 ft fallback tolerance
API option footprint=False uses the bare center test
the windward wall is taken for the garden only as a last resort; None if nothing fits
docstring: a polder parcel 'gives up its corners' (subtractive rounding) - no fallback
when no wind-facing margin has room for its belt, the best CRAMPED margin is seated - the windbreak belt runs partly off the canvas
rule: the windbreak stands 36-146 ft upwind of the cluster on the canvas (belt_polygon; settlement-review of Mizuguchi, feature 261, cluster.py:225-231: the belt left 'a strip ... holed where they stood in it')
reachable: rare (every wind-facing margin's band runs >20% off the canvas)
sketch: grow the canvas/frame upwind to take the belt, or shift the seat along the margin until the band fits; failing that a stated reduced-belt rule

what: when no margin faces within 45 deg of the wind, the best OFF-WIND margin is seated (recorded as seat_offwind)
rule: 背山面水 - the cluster's back to the windward side; 'a margin whose normal is more than 45 degrees off the wind is not a candidate at all' (WIND_BACK_MIN_DOT, seat_cluster docstring, feature 261)
reachable: rare (an envelope with no wind-facing margin clear of the drain, hem and brook)
sketch: constrain the field envelope/plan so a wind-facing flank always exists, or re-roll the plan when none does rather than seat off the wind

what: Bends a way round a field outline for at most `rounds` (6) passes and returns whatever it has when the rounds run out, even if a leg still crosses the outline.
rule: A track meeting a field goes round it (route_around docstring; lanes_clear_of_dry_plots / fields_clear_of_road gate tests, the Inashiro 2026-08-12 GM finding)
reachable: rare (an outline whose detour needs more than six splice rounds - deeply lobed fans or a leg re-entering after a splice)
sketch: Loop until no leg crosses (bounded by the ring's vertex count, since each splice consumes edges), then verify; if a crossing survives, refuse the track and hand back to connector_track's next bearing rather than returning a crossing path.

what: A leg with a single outline hit (a vertex graze) gets the hit point pushed out by `margin` and another round.
reachable: no (pragma no cover; a closed ring is crossed an even number of times)

what: A lane arm blocked early is truncated, and returns [] if the survivor is under 70 px (the old fallback of drawing the unclipped first segment was removed).
A hairpin at a lane joint is repaired into a T (the arriving lane drops its last leg), kept only when keeps_the_web holds.
History in a docstring: the tidy pass once dropped a 2.4 ft touch nub and the map shipped as two networks; now a crossing is recorded as a junction.
When no bearing/junction-distance candidate for the off-map drain brook scores zero, it draws the LEAST-BAD route, which may lie in the envelope, cross the field, turn over 55 deg, or run uphill.
rule: drainage_discharges_downhill, watercourses_flow_downstream, drainage_junction_smooth and streams_avoid_fields (the gate predicates this function's own comment says it scores against, sink.py ~433-470)
reachable: rare (pragma no cover: a fan that blocks every bearing at every junction distance; no cohort fan does)
sketch: Constrain first: widen the candidate set (more junction distances, longer run, route_around the envelope), then try the pond sink; if still none is clean, raise so the roll is refused rather than drawing a known-bad brook.

what: A tameike whose set-back exceeds POND_SETBACK_LIMIT is dropped and the field drains off the frame instead (water_sink='offmap').
reachable: rare (pragma no cover: a fan needing a tameike further out than the limit)

what: A pond the canvas clamp pulls back onto the crop (or off its solved seat) is dropped for the off-map sink.
When all fifteen upslope bearings clip the field envelope, the approach is drawn straight up the fall line regardless, crossing the rice.
rule: streams_avoid_fields - a stream does not run through a flooded paddy (feed_brook docstring, brook.py ~351-356)
reachable: no (pragma no cover: 'a fan head never blocks all fifteen'; kept as the loop's terminal)
sketch: Replace the terminal with route_around(plan.envelope, approach) and a verified clear result, or raise ValueError so the fan is refused, instead of returning a route known to cross.

what: With no houses placed yet, the gateway/spur origin falls back to the predicted band point.
reachable: no (houses always precede the track in the shipped stage order)

what: When route+clip and the four-step swing ladder all fail, returns `out` (a clipped run still crossing the steadings) or, if the clip died, the original `run` straight through them.
rule: houses_off_corridors, houses_clear_of_lanes, features_do_not_overlap; the function's own comment 'THE FALLBACK MUST NOT BE THE OFFENDING RUN' (track.py:194)
reachable: rare (run[0] inside the fabric or an obstacle next to it; the ladder's success path is pragma no cover and _route returns [] for frame-length connectors, so this terminal is what a blocked connector gets)
sketch: Return [] (a stated drop recorded in meta, as the spur's shortfall is) or move run[0] out of the fabric before routing; never return a run that _crosses_fabric.

what: With no wind-facing margin, the cluster seats on the best margin whose back faces off the wind and records meta.seat_offwind.
rule: The seat turns its back to the wind (WIND_BACK_MIN_DOT, hamletgen/consts.py:669-675, feature 261); 'the gate refuses [seat_offwind] on the pool' (test_pool_wind.py:51 asserts False)
reachable: rare (a fan whose every wind-facing margin is blocked by drain/hem; test_cluster.py:62 builds one)
sketch: Refuse (raise) on a live roll so the seed is re-rolled or the spec's fall/wind is revisited, or constrain the site plan so a wind-facing margin exists; keep the offwind seat only behind an explicit spec opt-in.

what: With no wind-facing margin that has belt room, it seats on a wind-facing margin whose belt band falls more than BELT_ROOM_MAX_OFF (20%) off the canvas.
reachable: rare (a cluster against the canvas edge on its windward side)

what: Spur target candidates: if none has a clean straight run, the least-violation one is used, then clip_to_clear takes it out of the crop and the marsh.
Comment explaining why a polder has no field spur (the least-bad spur used to cross the block).
A spur whose head no longer reaches the web is not drawn; its length is recorded (field_spur_ft) and a_way_onto_the_bund later runs the nearest lane to the bund.

When none of 41 bearings is clean of wet ground, steadings and crop, the connector returns the LEAST-BAD bearing (lexicographic wet, steadings, crop); only crop hits are repaired later by route_around.
rule: roads_clear_of_marsh (a track through a marsh is not a road, track.py ~590-600) and houses_off_corridors / features_do_not_overlap for steading hits (track.py ~614-630)
reachable: yes for crop-only violations (repaired downstream); rare for wet or steading violations (a cluster in a pocket of the fan with the toe marsh spanning the canvas)
sketch: Accept only candidates with soaked==0 and steaded==0; if none, widen the sweep (reach, bows, a second start on the cluster edge) and then refuse the seat, instead of returning a bearing through marsh or a house.

what: 'Falls back' here means the fringe recedes downwind; geometric description, not a fallback.
The spec's performance fallback: bamboo seats searched on a 16 ft lattice instead of 8 ft, same keep-outs.
Linework floored at 4 px so thin features stay visible (a drawing convention).
An empty filtered value space raises; explicitly no silent fallback.
The knob's default value 'wagon' for the no-pin, no-roll case.
When no gap in the reach window is wide enough, the lane cut goes at reach*0.5 ahead, not in a gap; the drawn lane is then broken up by what it runs into.
An unknown wall_defense tier is read as 'garrison'.
Frontage items that do not fit are dropped and the shortfall is printed and recorded in M['shortfalls'].
The legacy house-first placement path kept for non-to-scale (city) maps.
South is the documented default gate direction for a compound.
Superseded docstring on caption tilt ('no second edge family to fall back on').
A probe larger than the index slack falls back to the full scan; same answer, slower.
Best-effort south nudge of an east-shaded garden; a boxed-in garden stays put (gardens_unshaded_from_east flags only avoidable ones).
When no ring seat clears, retries with the field-envelope blocks suspended and a test against the drawn plots; a cluster still unseated is skipped.
`fallback` is the parent canal/thread a boundary follows above its takeoff - a structural definition, not a compromise.
A 180-degree fold has no shared miter, so the outgoing chord's normal is used (miter capped at 2x).
A cached plot geometry is dropped when the plot's ring is reassigned.
the power-law prediction of the fan multiplier falls back to the bracket midpoint when it lands on a bracket end
a saturated aspect stops once the bracket is under 0.03 wide and keeps the best legal net; fit_field re-runs the best aspect unprobed, so a field can land short of target acreage
reachable: rare (the envelope clamps the fan below target, e.g. cohort seed 47)

what: when no ring point out to 85 ft is clear, the door defaults to the straight step toward the target; the path built from it is still judged by the clip, steading-foul and bend tests below
a record of a coarse-then-fine router fallback that was tried and reverted
the first candidate whose run bends badly is kept as a stand-in when no run is clean; the result is still ranked by the fouls/bends test downstream and routed to the _folded last resort
reachable: rare (the comment records it as unreached in eight constructed geometries)

what: where the straight join to the network is not clear, a fine-lattice tail is routed within _LINK_DIRECTNESS; if that fails too the path stays unjoined and is dropped by the _LANE_JOIN_FT test

when neither cut is clean, the least-bad cut by (fouls, bends) is kept, and a cut that crosses a neighbor's yard or garden (_crosses_fabric against passable) can survive, because only a steading foul is re-tested later (_hits_a_steading)
rule: a lane may not overlap another household's fabric (the overlap matrix; stated at serve.py:550-555 'An overlap is a rule the matrix forbids outright', cohort seed 18 grazing a garden at 1.21 ft)
reachable: rare (both cuts foul, e.g. cohort seed 18)
sketch: Treat a fabric foul like a steading foul: skip the cut (continue to the next target way) rather than rank it, leaving the house unserved when no clean cut exists.

what: a door path that bends badly on every target way is still drawn as the least-bad fold so the house is served
rule: lanes_bend_like_paths (no turn past the bend bar; tests/gate/test_lane_network.py, tests/hamletgen/ways/test_geom.py:300)
reachable: rare (every way round is blocked, e.g. cohort seed 16's 71-then-61 degree fold)
sketch: Refuse the fold as the steading foul is refused, or repair it: route the path again with a turn-angle cost in the router so no candidate folds; else a stated drop reported by farmhouses_reach_a_way.

what: when every candidate fouls a steading or none ends worth walking to, the house is left with no way and recorded in _exhausted
rule: farmhouses_reach_a_way (every farmhouse is served by a way; named at serve.py:618-619 as the check that reports it)
reachable: rare (hemmed-in steadings; the comment at serve.py:388 records 2 unserved on cohort seeds 5 and 25)
sketch: Constrain the candidates upstream: have the homestead placer reserve a door corridor to the web before seating neighbors, so an unreachable seat is refused at seating rather than discovered here.

what: a join link that would touch a farmhouse is refused and the piece it was joining is kept orphaned (the trade serve.py:619 cites)
rule: lanes_form_one_network (the web is one connected network; stated at fabric.py:275-281)
reachable: rare (a join whose only short route runs past a house corner, e.g. sawada and kashikawa 2026-08-29)
sketch: Repair: route the join at WEB_FABRIC_GAP around the steading before refusing, and drop the orphan piece (a stated drop) only if its houses are served elsewhere.

what: with no fields or dry plots recorded, the plan's envelope stands in for the worked ground
reachable: rare (a map queried before the fields are laid)

what: the knob's default form when nothing is pinned or rolled
when no field margin faces the wind within 45 degrees, the best off-wind margin is taken and meta.seat_offwind is set
rule: the seat turns its back to the wind (WIND_BACK_MIN_DOT, hamletgen/consts.py:664-675, which says the gate refuses seat_offwind on the pool; tests/hamletgen/test_pool_wind.py)
reachable: rare (every wind-facing margin blocked by the drain or dry hem)
sketch: Refuse: raise as the no-margin case does, so the roll re-seeds or the plan re-aims the fan, instead of drawing an off-wind seat.

what: a wind-facing margin whose belt runs more than BELT_ROOM_MAX_OFF off the canvas is taken when no roomier wind-facing margin exists
reachable: rare (the brook across every roomy wind-facing band, Mizuguchi)

what: without PIL or the font, the title width is a calibrated estimate
the title tries the reserved pocket, then a blank scan, then cover (belt, bamboo, woodland), then a clear corner, then grows a title band above the map
with no view set, the title goes at the top center of the canvas with no clearance test
rule: title_clear_of_features (the placard may sit on cover, never on a building, plot, field, water, lane or label; finish.py:543, tests/settlement/test_label_placement.py)
reachable: no (both callers, hamletgen/frame.py:432 and settlement/rolling/roll.py:111, crop first)
sketch: Refuse: raise when title() is called before crop_to_content, since the docstring already requires the crop.

what: a note that the rasterizer deliberately has no fallback
a dropped field spur is recorded in meta.field_spur_swept; the end of the web runs on to the bund in its place (a_way_onto_the_bund)
a lane shorter than _LANE_MIN_FT after trimming is dropped as debris
a historical note naming a caption-seat picker fallback (_helpers.pick_caption_seat) that no longer exists in the tree
with no tree_crowns recorded, the canopy is indexed from grove clump bases, which under-measure the crowns
reachable: rare (hand-built fixtures, or a caller asking before groves are drawn, when no crowns exist to stand under)

what: when no seat above the traffic floor offers a caption at level 2, the board is still placed at the best level available (caption over a crown, or nowhere beside the board), and meta.kosatsuba_caption_level records it

reachable: yes (siting.py:557-559 names Sawada's entrance as having no departure-band seat with a clear caption)
sketch: Constrain the candidates: widen the anchor/handover band or the traffic floor until some seat reaches caption level 2, and refuse the placement only when none does, recorded as a stated drop.

what: with no main way declared, the board samples the whole network, then web lanes only when no non-web, non-connector lane exists; the busiest-node score stands in for 'main'
street runs with no lane records are added at a nominal 8 ft tread width
reachable: no (only a manifest with runs and no lane records)

what: the verge band is sampled first and the walk stops past the verge, where the roadside rule would drop the seat anyway
a seat clear of existing captions is preferred; with none, the busiest seat is taken even under a caption already on the map
reachable: rare (legacy hand-authored town and city scripts only; captions are seated in the later label phase, so M['labels'] is usually empty when this runs)

what: a coppice seat on the level beside the fields is taken only once ground above the fields is used up (the record's own second rank); downslope seats are never offered
a grown or mirrored parcel that does not fit falls back to the rung, and a rung under _COMMONS_FLOOR_FT drops the parcel (fewer parcels, not smaller)
a historical note about the retired square-parcel fallback
a sizing constant's note on why an under-sized band does not fail as a shortfall
a stable yard digs its own watering point only when no real well is in reach
reachable: rare (town/city stables with no well nearby)

what: a plain list is indexed fresh each call instead of cached
a note on building the bundle layout once per household (a cache)
the legacy threshing yard falls back from the south front to east or west, never north; None refuses the farmstead seat (_find_appurtenances)
where the supply canal does not reach a given u, the upslope bound falls outside the fan (nothing to exclude there)
when no host takes the scrap cleanly, the weld adding the fewest wall steps is taken
the least-lumpy weld under _WELD_MIN_SOLIDITY is taken when no clean host exists (a preference, not a veto, per banks.py:444)
the least-bad arrowhead weld is taken with no test against the gate's chevron line, unlike the needle fallback, which is held to _GATE_MIN_APEX
rule: a paddy basin does not read as an arrowhead: _CHEVRON_MIN_APEX / _CHEVRON_MIN_SOLIDITY, 'CAUGHT AT 40/0.90, GATED AT 35/0.85' (waterfields/banks.py:503-504)
reachable: rare (no jogging or lumpy host and a chevron host available)
sketch: Hold it to the gate line as the needle fallback is held to its line: take the chevron only if is_chevron(ring, 35, 0.85) is false, else leave the scrap bare (the recorded 'odd corner left unpaddied').

what: the least-bad needling weld is taken only if its apex clears the gate's line plus 1 deg; below that the scrap stays bare
when the owner pool runs out before target byres are seated, fewer are drawn; meta.byre_target records the ask
rule: byres_meet_their_target (a shortfall is a placement failure, not a settlement without oxen; tests/gate/test_cluster_and_homes.py:134-143)
reachable: rare (crowded ground where no spiral seat clears; courtyard form seated 8 of 16 on the cohort before the arm seat)
sketch: Reserve the byre with the homestead bundle (as the yard and garden are) so the count is guaranteed at seating, or widen the spiral reach for the shared form until the target is met.

what: a courtyard-form household whose arm seat and yard-shed seat fail takes the spiral within COURTYARD_REACH, and the record names its household
where neighbors break nowhere near the ideal cut, the grid falls back to even spacing
a repair that would take a basin under the size floor or to a needle is declined at the gate's line, and the ground lies bare
A refusal message names `make help` when the module has no registered target
When no candidate link joins an orphan way without crossing the brook and coming back, the out-and-back link is kept as the last resort and drawn
rule: A link must not cross the brook to the same bank and come back, 'two planks for nothing' (settlement-review of Mizuguchi, feature 261, stated in the comment at sweeps.py:302-304). This branch knowingly draws that form
reachable: rare (an orphan whose only routable candidates leave by one ford and return by another, e.g. Mizuguchi-type brook-in-the-cluster maps)
sketch: Constrain the router so the orphan and the network are joined along one bank, planning against the brook with no fords open when both ends are on the same bank. Where that fails, drop the link as a stated drop and let the straggler pass or the stranding re-roll handle the houses

what: A comment recording a tight-squeeze fallback that was tried and reverted (feature 126)
Pulls an unserving lane end back vertex by vertex (it stops at another lane's end that rests on it), and empties a lane whittled under _WEB_MIN_FT for _sweep_debris
The router returns [] (no route) for a lattice over 90,000 cells, so every connector is declined, and connector_track picks the bearing clear of the steadings instead
The title reservation tries a smaller 210x120 pocket, then an outside-the-content pocket at four corners with offsets, then reserves nothing (a degenerate box)
reachable: rare (the final no-reservation branch is pragma no cover)

what: title(): the reserved pocket, then a blank scan, then a cover-allowed scan (the placard may sit on a belt or wood), then clean corners, then a title band grown above the view. A no-view branch centers it at the top
reachable: rare (the band needs every corner to hide a plot, as on seed 13. The no-view branch is not reached because every live caller crops first). Residual: the band can still overlap a feature that runs off the north frame, which the comment says 'the check still reports', but that check is retired

what: After four lattice rounds, the rescue offers along-the-field ends and a wider random cloud. If the quota is still short after round 7, the map ships with fewer households and plan.placed records the shortfall, with no refusal or re-roll
rule: households_consistent: occupied farmhouses must be 0.85-1.05x the declared households (stages.py:131, research/settlements.html 'Is every household in a hamlet actually drawn?', tests/gate/test_generator_contracts.py:test_every_declared_household_is_seated). Only the gate's rolled seeds hold it
reachable: rare (a short or boxed margin band. Cohort seed 25 was 19 of 20 before the rescue took the ends, and Inashiro was 13 of 15)
sketch: Size the band from the household count before seating (as roll.py sizes need = households x pitch^2) and widen or re-seat until the floor is met. Otherwise refuse the roll (re-roll it, as the stranding re-roll does) when placed < 0.85 x households

what: Offers the front row again at a wider standoff when the first pass fell short
Comments on history (the 1.15 bound did not fix the shortfall, and a pass that was briefly called 'a fallback')
A fixture no house had room for is not drawn, and the miss is recorded in meta.farm_fixtures_unseated
rule: The per-hamlet PREVALENCE BAND rolled from the seed (fixtures.py:18-30, research/homesteads.html 'The farmstead's fixtures'. For example, the privy is near-universal, 'a separate outbuilding was the norm'). The drawing departs from its own rolled count, which the comment admits ('a drawing that departs from its own declared count'). Recording the miss is not the rule
